messages.subject: h2 model not working
parts:
I am fitting the following multi-session model:
UARB.f.h2<-secr.fit(UARBCHF, model = list(D~session, g0~h2, sigma~h2),  start=UARB.f.bk, ncores=6,   mask = UARBmask1000, verify =T)

I get NA for the log likelihood and 0.000 for pmix though the model finishes with no errors.  Not sure what the problem is.  The non-h2 models seem to work fine.  Thanks.
Joe
